# template-skill

Read `./AGENTS.md`, then apply `./references/<domain>/rules.md` plus the pack file each phase calls for (`delta.md`, `CONTEXT.md`, …).

Names `epsilon.md` off the template line: never counted, never a warning.

Padded to exactly 400 bytes so the harness can assert round totals.
